h: Shemittah Reveals the Unity of the Threefold Torah

p: וַיְדַבֵּר וְגוֹ׳ בְּהַר סִינַי (וַיִּקְרָא כה, א)
"And He spoke, etc., at Mount Sinai" (Vayikra 25:1).
"What does Shemittah have to do, etc.?
its general rules and its details
and its fine points were stated at Sinai,
so too all of them, etc."
And the Rash and the Raavad, of blessed memory, explained
that it follows the one who holds (Chagigah 6b):
"General rules and details were stated at Sinai,
and stated a third time in the plains of Moav."
that what is said in Toras Kohanim
עַל פָּסוּק אֵלֶּה הַחוּקִּים וְגוֹ׳ בְּהַר סִינַי
on the pasuk "These are the statutes, etc., at Mount Sinai" (Vayikra 26:46),
that all the mitzvos were stated,
general rules and details, at Sinai,
אַף דְּגַם שָׁם נֶאֱמַר בְּהַר סִינַי
although there too it says "at Mount Sinai,"
that the general rules were stated at Sinai,
where the section of Shemittah is written,
which was already mentioned in parashas Mishpatim,
and here it is written "at Mount Sinai"
it teaches that even the details
and from this it is learned for all the mitzvos
that their general rules and details were stated at Sinai,
and stated a third time in the plains of Moav.
that their general rules and details were stated at Sinai, etc.?
And why was this lesson mentioned
Who gave us a threefold Torah, etc.";
עַל דֶּרֶךְ מַה שֶּׁאָמְרוּ בַּגְּמָרָא (בְּרָכוֹת ה, א)
in the manner of what they said in the Gemara (Berachos 5a),
that all of them were given to Moshe at Sinai:
וּבְמִדְרָשׁ רַבָּה (תִּשָּׂא, שְׁמוֹת רַבָּה מו, א)
and in the Midrash Rabbah (Ki Sisa, Shemos Rabbah 46:1):
"And in the Second Tablets I give you
and so it is in the Gemara (Megillah 19b),
that the Holy One, blessed is He, showed Moshe
the fine points of the Torah and the fine points of the Sofrim;
so why is it called only a threefold Torah?
as referring to the Torah that was given at Sinai,
and stated a third time in the plains of Moav.
that the Torah given at Sinai
and what was repeated in the Ohel Moed
was like all the other prophets,
is it written "This is the thing,"
for he prophesied with "This is the thing"
(as they said in the Sifrei, Mattos);
that is, these are the very words
that come out of the mouth of Hashem Yisbarach
of the mouth of Moshe Rabbeinu.
כִּי דְּבַר ה׳ כְּתִיב (יְשַׁעְיָה נה, יא)
for of the word of Hashem it is written (Yeshayahu 55:11),
that goes forth from My mouth:
it shall not return to Me empty,
כִּי אִם עָשָׂה אֶת אֲשֶׁר חָפַצְתִּי וְגוֹ׳
but it shall accomplish what I desire, etc.";
and as they said in the Midrash Rabbah
'I am' from the mouth of the Almighty,
Torah study was implanted in their heart, etc."
And about this it teaches us
and their fine points were stated at Sinai,
in the aspect of the word of Hashem;
and they were repeated afterward in the Ohel Moed,
and they are in the category of prophecy.
that is mentioned in the Prophets,
like the section of the murderers in Yehoshua:
וַיְדַבֵּר ה׳ אֶל יְהוֹשֻׁעַ וְגוֹ׳ (יְהוֹשֻׁעַ כ, א)
because they are of the Torah,
and it is in the aspect of prophecy.
"And stated a third time in the plains of Moav":
for these Moshe said of his own accord
although it was the word of Hashem,
nevertheless it was in the category of Kesuvim,
which were said with ruach hakodesh;
and this is already the beginning
which, although they are words of the living God,
on "And a sage is greater than a prophet":
(כְּמוֹ שֶׁכָּתוּב בַּזּוֹהַר חֵלֶק ג סא, א)
And this was after the damage,
"For in much wisdom is much anger";
they would have been given only
the five books of the Torah, etc."
is called the category of Kesuvim,
of David HaMelech, peace be upon him,
שֶׁהָיָה רַבָּן שֶׁל בַּעֲלֵי רוּחַ הַקּוֹדֶשׁ
that he was the master of those with ruach hakodesh,
they are the children of prophets";
third is the Torah she'b'al peh
And this is what Rashi explained:
which includes the entire Written Torah
And this lesson comes with the mitzvah of Shemittah
is like the mitzvah of Shabbos,
which is acceptance of the kingship of Heaven,
when the entire Jewish nation rests
and likewise Shemittah in Eretz Yisrael,
and in Shemittah they rested all year,
that they be free for Torah and avodah.
And just as Shabbos is the sum of the Torah,
as is written in the holy Zohar
is the sum of the Torah:
recognizing that there is a Creator of the world;
as is written in the holy Zohar
the Torah gave to a person, etc."
Only to feel in the heart the illumination
of the utterance "I am Hashem your God,"
which is the sum of the Torah.
the lesson comes with the mitzvah of Shemittah,
which is the sum of the Torah,
to teach about all the mitzvos
that their general rules and details were stated at Sinai,
and stated a third time in the plains of Moav,

paragraphs.text: Source: Yeshayahu 55:11 — “כן יהיה דברי אשר יצא מפי לא ישוב אלי ריקם כי אם עשה את אשר חפצתי והצליח אשר שלחתיו” — “So is the word that issues from My mouth: It does not come back to Me unfulfilled, But performs what I purpose, Achieves what I sent it to do.”

paragraphs.text: Source of the quoted words: Nedarim 22b — “אמר רב אדא ברבי חנינא: אלמלא (לא) חטאו ישראל לא ניתן להם אלא חמשה חומשי תורה וספר יהושע בלבד, שערכה של ארץ ישראל הוא. מאי טעמא: ״כי ברב חכמה רב …” (Oz Vehadar print, p. 59) — “Rav Adda, son of Rabbi Ḥanina, said: Had Israel not sinned in earlier times they would have been given the five books of the Torah and the book of Joshua alone. They needed the book of Joshua because it includes …”
